catches: A promo code is required on the application — applying without it disqualifies you.
Within 90 days of opening you must complete both: at least two qualifying ACH direct deposits (employer/payroll/benefit) totaling $2,000 AND at least 15 qualifying debit card purchases.
Direct deposits must be qualifying employer/payroll/benefit ACH — bank-to-bank transfers do not count.
Account must stay open and in good standing for at least 90 days.
No published end date — Broadway Bank says the offer is subject to change at any time.
Not available to existing checking holders, reopened or converted accounts, or anyone who was a signer on a Broadway checking account within the last 12 months.
